text:
Nina: heads up — onboarding sample started failing on Android 14: streaming upload + auth retry causes `Request body already consumed` when Authenticator replays. Repro and snippets below.

Omar: can you paste client + minimal stack?

Nina: client: ```kotlin
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .addInterceptor(AuthInterceptor())
  .authenticator(TokenAuthenticator())
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .build()
``` stack: ```
java.io.IOException: Request body already consumed
 at okhttp3.internal.http2.Http2ExchangeCodec.writeRequestBody(...)
```

Li: this is the usual non-repeatable body problem — streaming bodies can't be replayed after a 401-triggered refresh. Two pragmatic options: 1) buffer small uploads so they become repeatable; 2) for large streams, fail fast on 401 and let caller re-run upload after refresh. Also consider disabling `.retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` on auth-sensitive clients so low-level retries don't complicate things.

Omar: added a check in AuthInterceptor to detect streaming bodies (contentLength() == -1) and skip automatic replay, logging a warning. Also added a tiny helper `OkHttpClients.forUploads()` in sample which sets `.retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` and a short doc blurb.

Nina: PR open `devex/avoid-replay-streaming-uploads` with unit that simulates non-repeatable body and emulator run. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/4411

android-ci: Build 4411 passed (emulator API 34) - onboarding instrumental tests OK :white_check_mark:

Li: follow-ups: add note to SDK docs about streaming/upload semantics and recommend helper factory. Also add integration test that uses a chunked request to catch regressions.

Nina: will file tickets for docs + e2e. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
